Method of Attack: Bypass Grub password authentication via integer underflow vulnerability in grub_username_get() and grub_password_get() functions
Elevation of privilege without valid username or password
Information disclosure by loading customized kernel and initramfs
Denial of service by overwriting disk data including grub
Impacted Systems: Linux systems using affected Grub versions
Attack Vector: Local access to system required; exploit triggered by pressing Backspace key 28 times at username prompt
Indicators of Compromise: System reboots or GRUB Rescue Shell appears after pressing Backspace key 28 times at username prompt
